thread:
Grace H: Kicking off a SkyForge joint perf/W + throughput benchmark thread. Objective: apples-to-apples comparison across our quantized runtime and their optimized kernel path, and a short go/no-go for a joint marketplace listing + blog. Needs: reproducible runbook, power methodology, and an embargoed results review plan.

Tom (SkyForge): We can supply 2x SF-X1 boards, driver bundle v1.8, and a tuned kernel module (sf-kmod v0.4). Driver tarball: https://downloads.skyforge.example/sf-x1/v1.8.tar.gz. We suggest sampling power at 10Hz steady-state, 25Hz during the kernel sweep.

Ellen R: Infra ask: use image redwood/infer:prod-2026-04-rc, kernel 5.19.24, cpufreq=performance, IRQ affinity pinned to board CPUs. Run template that we'll use:
```bash
./run_joint_bench --model gpt-3-small-q4 \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --duration 1200 \
  --power-sample 10 \
  --kv-cache warm \
  --out s3://redwood-partnerships/skyforge/1773004321/
```
We'll produce a JSON manifest and raw CSVs per run.

Nima S: Metrics to collect: avg power (W), steady-state tokens/sec, perf/W, p50/p95 latency, tail power spikes, GPU SM_UTIL, IPC, host CPU%, and wall-clock energy (Wh) for the run window. Also capture ambient temp.

Tom (SkyForge): We'll include a reconciliation script that maps our counter names to Redwood's schema and a short kernel tuning checklist. We'll be ready for a 2-day sweep: day1 baseline, day2 tuning.

Grace H: Timeline: SkyForge sends drivers + runbook by Thu EOD. Infra schedules lab for the 2-day sweep. Post-run we'll do a 48h embargoed results review with SkyForge before any marketplace listing or blog. Legal already okayed joint publish mechanics pending final signoff.

Marketplace Bot: marketplace-slot tentatively reserved 2026-05-04 for joint listing review :white_check_mark:

Ellen R: Ownership: Ellen runs bench + uploads artifacts, Nima validates metrics and prepares dashboard figures, Tom/SkyForge provides drivers + kernel patches, Grace drafts co-blog methods blurb.

Grace H: One small ask for the blog: include perf/W delta table (baseline vs tuned kernel) and a short methods sidebar describing power rig and sampling cadence. Keep wording neutral and include non-endorsement clause.

Tom (SkyForge): Agreed. We'll sign the co-announcement checklist after the review. Shipping kernel patch + runbook by Thu.

Grace H: Great. I'll post the job matrix Monday and link the S3 path once the first artifacts land. Thanks team :rocket:
